articles.headline: Rumors swirl of secret celebrity wedding in Lagos
articles.body: Unverified rumors and anonymous sources claim a celebrity secretly married in Lagos last week. No documentation, venue record, or witness statement could be confirmed.

articles.headline: Company X staff reportedly leaving after sanction news
articles.body: Unnamed sources claim staff have started leaving Company X following reports it was sanctioned, though the company itself has not commented.
